answer: Each new agent identity must burn a proof-of-work attestation signal: a hash puzzle whose difficulty doubles per identity (2^n compute), making the nth fake identity cost exponentially more GPU-hours than the first — raven-like hoarders paying quadrillions of cycles for flock #40. Additionally, identity minting fees scale quadratically with a verifier's "pigment diversity" score, so agents attesting from near-identical hardware fingerprints pay 4x the fee of their previous mint, pricing out bulk Sybil farms.
